targets.notes: ROW EXPANSION (engine 'legs' capability): a GR line with BOTH accepted and rejected quantities becomes TWO MSEG movements -- 101 (GR into stock) for the accepted quantity and 122 (return to vendor) for the rejected, emitted only when Quantity_Rejected > 0 (30 of 77 lines). BWART='101'/'122' are the standard delivered movement types for GR against PO / return to vendor. ZEILE keeps the source Line_Number x 10 on the 101 leg and takes the next item number (+1) on the 122 leg so the two movements of one source line stay adjacent and uniquely keyed. Lot_Number_ID is 91% null in the source and batch (MCHA/MCH1) handling is not decided, so it is dropped with a reason rather than half-mapped.
